Hong Kong's Sotheby's just set a Cartier record: a white-gold Cheich sold for HK$26.52 million, the highest price ever paid for any Cartier wristwatch. The 2010 commission, a Paris-Dakar trophy piece numbered one of one, also set the record for a quartz watch. It beat Cartier's prior record of US$2 million.

Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio.

香港蘇富比創下卡地亞拍賣紀錄：一枚獨一無二的白金Cheich腕錶以2,652萬港元成交，是歷來卡地亞腕錶的最高拍賣價；由於機芯為石英，同時也創下石英錶的最高拍賣紀錄。

Gold in Hong Kong tonight: HK$40,512 a tael, HK$1,082 a gram (-0.41%), silver HK$16,344 a kilogram (-0.53%).
